beats.name: hook
beats.said: A man has bored 82 holes in a plank as an enemy army marches on his fort.
beats.shown: Protagonist drilling a holed board by a stone wall, swoop to the drill throwing chips, whip up the wall to a valley with a tiny army and a parasol general.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Others sharpen swords while he keeps drilling; the commander mocks him, asking if this is battle or cheese-grating.
beats.shown: Dissolves to soldiers at the gate, the protagonist drilling in the corner, then the plumed commander sneering with an animated mouth (10-12.6 s).

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Board on a cart, fused tubes in every hole, one forbidden rope; he slaps a soldier's hand.
beats.shown: Cart and board by the red tower, macro pull-out through paper-wrapped tubes and strings, rope twisting, soldiers watching, slap with a red-pink arc (26 s), dusk at 27-28 s.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Night rain: he shields the cart with his coat, lying on it; one leak means everyone dies.
beats.shown: Blue-violet rainy rampart with glowing lanterns; protagonist leaps onto the cart and lies under a purple coat while two soldiers look up.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Army storms the walls at dawn; defenders panic while he waits for the enemy to bunch up.
beats.shown: Dawn dissolve to the yellow army charging in dust, shouting defenders around the calm protagonist, three push-ins on the packed enemy crowd with grinning and screaming faces.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: He uncovers the cart, ignites the rope; the fuse splits into 82 flames, each launching an arrow.
beats.shown: Red cloth flies off, spark runs along the rope, radial burst of golden rays, macro close-ups of rocket tubes with strong bloom.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: All 82 rockets leave the cart together and scatter, yet the enemy is so densely packed that...
beats.shown: Flash and fire jets at the cart, white smoke trails over the valley, top-down view of the army line catching orange fireballs.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: Every single rocket finds a target; he stands arms crossed, smug, before a mushroom cloud.
beats.shown: Orange explosion dissolves to the protagonist on a wall, arms crossed with a smirk, mushroom cloud darkening behind him; the video stops on that image.

hook.first_frame: Protagonist (red coat, white headband, bored half-lidded face) bent over a tall holed wooden board, hand-drilling; grey stone fort wall with a blue tiger banner behind, bright grass in front; caption 'He' at 70% height.
hook.first_3s: 0-1 s slow push-in on the driller; 1-2 s fast swoop to the drill throwing wood chips into the holed board; 2-3 s whip up the wall past banner and pavilion to a wide valley with a tiny marching army.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title promises the outcome (a cart stops an army); the first line opens on an odd action (82 drilled holes) and withholds the cart, so the title's payoff stays hidden until the end.

story.real_fact_core: A cart panel drilled with dozens of holes holds rocket arrows whose fuses are twisted into one rope, so one flame launches every rocket at once (hwacha-style launcher; estimate).
story.protagonist: Deadpan engineer-soldier in a white headband and red coat who builds and guards the launcher cart.
story.authority_or_antagonist: Plumed commander who mocks him; the yellow-uniformed attacking army.

tone.humour: Dry absurdity: a cheese-grater jibe from the commander, a man as a human umbrella, and an understated punchline over a mushroom cloud.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Protagonist keeps a half-lidded deadpan face in nearly every shot; absurd actions are stated flatly; the smug arms-crossed pose before the explosion lands the irony.
tone.dialogue_style: Only two quoted lines, both from side characters whose mouths animate; the protagonist never speaks; one narrator voices them (estimate, audio not heard).

character_style.outline: Thick uniform-weight black ink outline (about 2-3% of body height, estimate) on characters and hand-held props; the 3D set has no outlines.
character_style.shading: Flat white heads; clothes use small repeating texture patterns (mesh, dots, stripes, beard hatching); helmets have a soft grey gradient; almost no cel shading.
character_style.consistency_between_shots: Proportions, outline weight and costumes stay identical across all takes; only pose and face sprites change, and figures are scaled by distance.

animation.body_motion: Rigid cut-out puppet motion: whole bodies slide, tilt or hop (leap onto the cart at 32 s), thin limbs bend at simple joints, heads bob on stressed words; looks keyframed, not mocap (estimate).
animation.eyes_and_blinks: Eyes swap between drawn sprites (flat half-lidded dots, wide ringed circles, angry brows); no blink seen in 18 sampled frames.
animation.idle_motion: Held poses are almost frozen: the commander's helmet bobs on spoken words, the driller's head dips with the crank, the lying pose (f990-f1005) only tilts its head; life comes from camera drift, rain and lantern glow.
animation.squash_and_stretch: Little: the helmet lifts off the head on a bob (f366-f369) and the leaping body is stretched into a long horizontal shape (f960); otherwise rigid shapes.

generation_evidence.observation: Whip pan from the board up a wall corner past banner and pavilion to the valley in about 0.7 s; perspective, banner and brick courses stay geometrically consistent with no blur or warping.
Blue banner emblem (white tiger, yellow chevron, fringe) and brick mortar lines are identical and crisp in two frames of one push-in; the same banner recurs at f66, f240 and f420.
Commander's mouth cycles through about four fixed drawn shapes in 1.1 s and his helmet lifts off the head on a bob: a layered 2D puppet, not frame-by-frame generation.
Characters stand on sunlit stone with no cast or contact shadow while the cart and railings shade the floor: flat 2D art pasted into a lit 3D set.
Mushroom cloud is a smooth painterly sprite with a flat white ring that darkens over 1 s, in front of a blocky low-res wall texture: stock-style VFX over an engine set.
Foreground grass changes shape and brightness between consecutive frames while the characters and arch stay put: real-time grass sway or LOD, not AI morphing.

could_not_determine: Narrator voice (human vs TTS, any voice change for quoted lines): audio was not listened to in this by-eye review.
Whether mouth swaps are hand-keyed or auto lip-sync: only one speaking moment (11.5-12.6 s) was sampled at 3-frame steps; lip-sync label is an estimate.
Engine or software (Unreal, Unity, Blender, other) and whether the 2D characters are billboards, flat meshes or compositing layers: not decidable from frames.
Blinks: none seen in 12 frames (1.1 s, commander) and 6 frames (2.5 s, rain scene); blinking elsewhere is unchecked.
Eight orange suspects (1.17, 2.03, 2.33, 18.30, 22.00, 26.00, 54.00, 61.03 s) judged camera moves or VFX, not joins; 22.00 s is an in-place foreground-grass swap (estimate).
Hidden joins in the 22.6 s span 14.2-36.8 s: place and time of day change (dusk to night at 28-29 s) with no detected join; frames between contact-sheet seconds were not inspected.
Camera shake: none seen in the 12-frame whip-pan sample; faster moves at 53-55 s were only seen on four consecutive frames.
